title: Shopping and Clothes

story.title: Dilnoza’s birthday shopping
story.text: Dilnoza’s birthday was on Saturday, and she wanted something new to wear. On Friday she went to a big **shopping centre** with her sister. | First, they looked at **dresses**. Dilnoza found a beautiful blue dress, but the **price** was very high – it was too **expensive** for her. Then they saw a sign: “**Sale**! 50% **discount**!” | She **tried on** three dresses. The first one didn’t **fit** – it was the wrong **size**. The second one was **fashionable** but not **comfortable**. The third one was perfect! She also bought a pair of white **trainers** and a warm **scarf** for her mum. | She wanted to **pay by card**, but the card machine wasn’t working, so she paid **in cash**. | On the way home they went to the **market** and bought fruit – it’s always **cheap** there. “I didn’t **spend** too much **money**,” Dilnoza said happily. Next time, maybe she will shop **online**!

answers: Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?
**I prefer shopping in shops because** I can **try on** clothes. Online the **size** is often wrong. **For example**, last month I bought a jacket online and it didn’t **fit**.
What do you usually wear at the weekend?
**I usually wear** jeans and a T-shirt **because it’s comfortable**. I hardly ever wear a suit – only at weddings!
speech: Hello! Today I want to talk about shopping. To be honest, I don’t love shopping, but I go to the shopping centre once a month. **I prefer shopping in shops because** I can try things on. Online, **it** often **doesn’t fit me**. **I usually wear** jeans and trainers **because** they’re **comfortable**. The last thing I bought was a warm coat for winter – it was on sale, so it wasn’t expensive. **I don’t like spending a lot of money on** clothes. I prefer to spend money on books and travelling. Thank you!
